description: A Flutter widget implementing an auto-advancing offers carousel with dot indicators, displaying promotional banners.

classes.name: OffersCarousel
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays a carousel of promotional banners with automatic page switching and dot indicators.

classes.name: _OffersCarouselState
classes.description: State class managing the carousel's current index, page controller, timer, and building the widget.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the page controller and sets up a periodic timer to auto-advance the carousel.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the page controller and cancels the timer.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the carousel, including PageView and dot indicators.
